tasks.title: Published api and probe images pass strict auth, token, audit and restart e2e checks
tasks.spec: ## Repository: deploy, Behavior (Required behavior items 1-7 and implementation notes), Checks and Acceptance evidence 1-7; Release prerequisites, Risks, Counterexamples, Performance impact, Security impact and Rollout order. One task keeps the single-script integration checks, both qualifying image pins and the README change together. scripts/bump-images.sh is included because the section's Files parenthetical names it as the pin-writing tool; use it unchanged, with no edit to the helper itself. Check release prerequisites first; request a needs-input hold naming any missing qualifying release. Also hold on changed probe reason texts or rejected fixtures as Risks requires; do not weaken checks or silently reshape fixtures.

acceptance.command: gh api repos/lorenzh/pulse-api/git/refs/tags/v<api-version> --jq .object.sha; gh api repos/lorenzh/pulse-api/compare/e1153f99ba3466f6509d29760896e2cdf5061fb5...v<api-version> --jq .status; gh api repos/lorenzh/pulse-probe/git/refs/tags/v<probe-version> --jq .object.sha; gh api repos/lorenzh/pulse-probe/compare/a5dc88d5473a9c63cfd984988201da32cd15ec5c...v<probe-version> --jq .status
acceptance.expected: All requests exit 0; each compare status is ahead or identical. Chosen releases contain the api #617 and probe #552 marker commits respectively. Record both tags and returned SHAs in the PR. If either qualifying published release is missing, request a needs-input hold naming it; no skipped or version-switched checks against old images. Release creation remains a person's prerequisite.

acceptance.command: scripts/bump-images.sh api=<api-version> probe=<probe-version> && scripts/bump-images.sh --verify && git diff main -- common/services.yaml
acceptance.expected: Exit 0; --verify prints ok: for all five pulse services, comparing pins to independent ghcr.io digests. The diff changes exactly the api and probe image lines. Status, notify and console remain at 0.1.0; no other image pin changes. Record the api and probe digests and verify output in the PR.

acceptance.command: bash e2e/metric-is.test.sh && bash e2e/manual-count.test.sh && bash e2e/published-port.test.sh && bash e2e/outage-history.test.sh && scripts/check-setup.sh && bash scripts/check-setup.test.sh && bash scripts/secrets-init.test.sh && bash scripts/bump-images.test.sh && bash scripts/wait-ready.test.sh && bash scripts/init-secrets.test.sh
acceptance.expected: Exit 0 for every helper test and static setup check of the lint job.

acceptance.command: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run check && bun run build && git diff --exit-code -- dist
acceptance.expected: Exit 0; CLI lint, typecheck, full tests with the existing coverage gate and build pass. No tracked dist changes.

acceptance.command: In separate baseline-main and implementation checkouts, run scripts/init-secrets.sh && docker compose -f full/compose.yaml pull && scripts/measure.sh full; tear each stack down with docker compose -f full/compose.yaml down -v before starting the next run or the e2e
acceptance.expected: Both measurements exit 0 and report start time in seconds and RSS in MiB. Quote the before/after output in the PR for information only; no new performance budget. Teardown frees the ports before compose e2e.

Exit 0 on the qualifying images. Manual incidents prints exactly 'ok: a write without a token answers 401, a probe token write answers 403'; missing credentials get exactly 401 and a probe credential exactly 403. The failure text for the latter is 'a probe token write was not refused with 403'. '==> Tokens and audit' runs after the read-only-mount check and before persistence, with an ok: line for each of Required behavior 2.1-2.6. Scope check: create e2e-read-checks with [read,checks] gets 201, secret is a string and token.id matches ^tok_[0-9a-f]{24}$; its valid POST for unused e2e-scope-denied with Content-Type application/json and current If-Match gets exactly 403, with no such check in GET /checks, unchanged config ETag and unchanged check/create/ok counter line. Rotation check: creating the isolated probe token at location e2e-rotated gets 201; A gets 200 on /probe/checks; rotate with {} gets 200, a different secret B and numeric previousValidUntil; A and B each get 200 during overlap, B gets exactly 403 on /admin/audit, revoke gets 200, then A and B each get exactly 401 on /probe/checks. Neither stack bootstrap token is rotated or revoked.

acceptance.command: Inspect the audit, export, secrecy and throttle assertions and the output of the same successful bash e2e/compose-e2e.sh run (Required behavior 2.3-2.6 and 3)
acceptance.expected: Audit query /admin/audit?action=check.create&targetId=e2e-api gets 200 and holds a check.create entry with target.kind check, target.id e2e-api and actor.name e2e; retain its id. Query targetKind=token&targetId=<rotated token id> holds token.create, token.rotate and token.revoke, each attributed to e2e. Export gets 200, is nonempty, each line independently passes jq -e 'type == "object"', and includes the retained check.create id. Fixed-string checks find none of the four secrets (e2e admin, read/checks, A, B) in either query body, export or pre-restart compose logs; fail messages name place and role only. No pulse_api_admin_auth_throttled_total series is above 0; only the four specified failed admin authentications are sent. After down/up, the same e2e admin token gets 200 on /admin/config, the retained audit id is returned by the check.create query, and after every service is healthy new-container logs contain none of the four secrets. Secrets stay in shell variables; token-bearing responses are parsed with jq -e without printing secrets or whole responses. Existing assert_absent needles and all other assertions, publishing, cleanup and clean stop stay intact. Output includes the new persistence successes and ends with '==> All checks passed'.

acceptance.command: In an uncommitted scratch copy with the new image pins, restore the issue's historical 401-only probe-write assertion and its failure text, then run bash e2e/compose-e2e.sh; discard the scratch change
acceptance.expected: Exit 1 in Manual incidents with 'FAIL: a probe token write was not refused'. Quote the output in the PR and explain that deploy main accepted both 401 and 403, so unchanged main cannot demonstrate this historical red.

acceptance.command: In an uncommitted scratch copy, restore only the api image line from git show main:common/services.yaml (api 0.1.0), keep the new script and probe pin, then run bash e2e/compose-e2e.sh; discard the scratch pin change
acceptance.expected: Exit 1 in Manual incidents with 'FAIL: a probe token write was not refused with 403'; api 0.1.0 answers 401. Quote the output in the PR. The committed pin remains the qualifying new api release.

acceptance.command: In an uncommitted scratch copy with the new pins, delete only PULSE_PROBE_HEADER_HOSTS from e2e/compose.e2e.yaml, prepare e2e/rw/checks.json as the script's Setup does, run scripts/init-secrets.sh --dir e2e/.secrets, then COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME=pulse-e2e COMPOSE_FILE=full/compose.yaml:e2e/compose.e2e.yaml PULSE_SECRETS_DIR=$PWD/e2e/.secrets docker compose up -d; poll GET /checks on the published loopback api port for at most 90 seconds; tear down the same project with down -v and discard the scratch change
acceptance.expected: Within 90 seconds e2e-post has state down and lastReason exactly 'header Authorization env PULSE_HEADER_SVC_TOKEN is not bound to host e2e-target', from probe src/client.ts:160. Quote this alongside the green run's 'e2e-post is up' and 'e2e-post is up again'. The committed binding overlay and e2e-post scenario are unchanged; no denial fixture is added.

acceptance.command: git diff main -- README.md e2e/compose-e2e.sh && git diff --name-only main
acceptance.expected: Changes are limited to e2e/compose-e2e.sh, common/services.yaml and README.md. The README e2e paragraph names token scopes, rotation/revocation, audit query/export and persistence across restart, without image versions. Script changes implement Required behavior 1-3 and preserve items 4 and 7, including existing assertions, exact reason comparisons, secret needle checks, loopback publishing, cleanup and clean stop. No target, workflow, CLI or setup files change.
Exit 0; CI jobs check, lint, pins, minimal, full, demo, dev and cli-* are green. Include command outputs and the full job result in the PR evidence.

acceptance.command: gh pr view <pr> --json body --jq .body; gh pr view <pr> --json body --jq .body | grep -cF e2e-admin-token-sentinel
acceptance.expected: Body includes release tags, SHAs, marker-compare results, ghcr.io digests and verification; both status-code red runs; green full e2e; binding deny and allowed evidence; before/after full measurements; required check results; and evidence for each applicable Security impact item (secret absence including both log phases, exact auth statuses and dependency pins). It contains no credential or full token response. grep prints 0 (exit 1 for no match).
